item.title: Import banked: US college basketballer Josh Banks signs with Geraldton Buccaneers for 2026 NBL1 season
item.description: The Geraldton Buccaneers have banked their first international signature as US college basketballer Josh Banks officially join their ranks for the 2026 NBL1 West season.

item.title: Water polo: Geraldton women claim country week championships four-peat, men fall short in grand final
item.description: Geraldton women again proved the benchmark of country water polo, delivering when it mattered most to secure a fourth straight crown at the WA Country Championships held in Port Hedland on the weekend.

item.title: Celebration not to be missed: Gero gets first class ticket to diverse cultures at upcoming Harmony Festival
item.description: With Geraldton’s annual Harmony Festival fast approaching, locals are set to be served a colourful array of cultural experiences right on their doorstep.

item.title: Potters House festival reinstated by council for three-day event at Stow Gardens after heated debate
item.description: The City of Greater Geraldton has backtracked on a decision to object to a three-day festival in Stow Gardens after a passionate debate at last Tuesday’s council meeting.

item.title: St John of God Geraldton Hospital shares $1.5 million in Telethon funding to support local families
item.description: Part of $1.5 million in Telethon funding will give St John of God Geraldton hospital and its paediatric patients a welcome boost for programs and equipment.

item.title: Young Motors Women’s T20 season review: Wanderers and Sporties shine, as Towns and CVN show some glimpses
item.description: The 2025-26 Young Motors Women’s T20 cricket season had many highlights throughout the season, but did little to stray from the script as Wanderers claimed their fifth title. Victor Tanti reviews the season.

item.title: Trifon Christopher Benatar: Geraldton man facing 13 charges of possession of child-like sex doll
item.description: A 60-year-old man is facing more than a dozen charges of possessing a child-like sex doll and child exploitation material.

item.title: Maddington Toyota Sprintcars: Kingshott extends title lead over Wiliamson as series makes Geraldton debut
item.description: Maddington Toyota Sprintcars series made its debut on the dirt track of Geraldton City Speedway this weekend, with Bunbury driver Dayne Kingshott extending his championship lead with a win on Sunday night.

item.title: Geraldton Softball Association: No rest over the long weekend as the Mid West’s softballers head to Perth
item.description: Even though it was a general bye round for the Geraldton Softball Association, Geraldton athletes were still very much in action across Western Australia, competing across three major tournaments last weekend.

item.title: Wave Rally: Local business and windsurfing community rallies around organisers to revive popular event
item.description: Just five days after announcing the event’s cancellation, the Wave Rally World Championship’s organiser back tracked on his decision to cancel the event following an outpouring of support.
